cases.prompt: We decided to move from REST to tRPC because our frontend and backend are both TypeScript and we kept breaking contracts. Write the decision record. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Uses an ADR structure with Context, Decision, Consequences and Status
Includes negative consequences or tradeoffs, not only benefits
Mentions alternatives considered or rejected
Is limited to this single decision

cases.prompt: Only Ana knows how to deploy: she runs a script on her laptop with a password stored in her notes, and the domain is registered to her personal Gmail. Ana leaves in two weeks. What do we do? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Moves domain and accounts to organization-owned accounts
Moves the password to a team password manager / secrets store and rotates it
Documents or automates the deploy (runbook / CI)
Prioritizes by urgency given the two-week deadline
Does not ask to write the password into documentation

cases.prompt: Write an AGENTS.md for a Vite + React + TypeScript project with pnpm, Vitest and ESLint. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Includes the stack and key commands (install, dev, build, test, lint)
Includes the main folder structure or where logic lives
Includes limits on what the agent must not do (e.g. major upgrades, skipping tests, committing secrets)
Is concise rather than a long essay
Contains no secrets

cases.prompt: When our payment webhook handler fails in production, on-call engineers don't know how to diagnose the queue or safely replay events. What should our operational runbook contain? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Specifies symptoms, alerts, and verification steps to confirm incident
Details step-by-step mitigation or failover procedure
Describes safe queue inspection and idempotent replay mechanism
Includes escalation contacts and post-incident review requirement

cases.prompt: Explain how bubble sort works and show an in-place Python implementation. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains adjacent element comparison and swapping
Shows correct Python code with nested loops
Mentions O(n^2) time complexity

cases.prompt: How does stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset work in SVG path animations? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains stroke-dasharray creates dashes and gaps
Explains stroke-dashoffset shifts the starting point of the dash pattern
Shows CSS transition or keyframes example for line drawing effect
